UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated smart home member profile stored strictly under the owner's UID.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner.

displayName.description: Display name of the home member.

email.description: Email address of the home member (private PII).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserHouseholdLink.title: UserHouseholdLink
UserHouseholdLink.description: Pointer stored under a user's private subcollection linking their UID to their active household.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

homeId.description: Household document ID the user belongs to.

role.description: Role of the user in the linked household.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the household link was updated.

HomeState.title: HomeState
HomeState.description: Simulated smart home appliance and automation mode state for a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the state owner.

lightOn.description: Simulated living room light power state.

doorOpen.description: Simulated front door open/closed sensor state.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the device state was last updated.

ActivityEntry.title: ActivityEntry
ActivityEntry.description: Simulated home activity log entry owned by the authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the activity owner.

icon.description: Icon category for the activity item.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity occurred.

AutomationRoutine.title: AutomationRoutine
AutomationRoutine.description: User-customizable smart home automation routine configuration (Sleep, Morning, Away).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the routine owner.

lightAction.description: Configured action for the living room light.

fanAction.description: Configured action for the bedroom fan.

fanSpeed.description: Target fan speed (1 to 5) when fanAction is turn_on.

doorAction.description: Configured safety-checked action for the front door.

requireSafetyConfirmation.description: Whether locking an unlocked closed door requires explicit confirmation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the routine configuration was saved.

Household.title: Household
Household.description: Shared smart home household root document containing bounded active member UIDs.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the primary household owner.

memberUids.description: Bounded list (max 20) of active member UIDs in the household.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the household was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the household was last updated.

FamilyMember.title: FamilyMember
FamilyMember.description: Authorized household member record with role and granular permissions.

memberId.description: Document ID of the member (UID for active signed-in users).

homeOwnerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the household owner.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID when linked, or empty string while pending sign-in.

email.description: Lowercase email address of the authorized member.

status.description: Whether the member has an active linked account or is awaiting sign-in.

canControlDevices.description: Permission to toggle lights and fan controls.

canRunAutomations.description: Permission to run automation scenes and routines.

canUseVoiceCommands.description: Permission to issue voice assistant commands from their own account.

canUnlockDoor.description: Permission to unlock the front door via device/UI confirmation.

canManageFamily.description: Permission to invite, add, remove, and update member permissions.

inviteCode.description: Optional invite code used when accepting an invitation.

addedByUid.description: UID of the admin/owner who added this member.

viewerUids.description: Bounded list (max 20) of active household UIDs allowed to query members.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was last updated.

FamilyInvite.title: FamilyInvite
FamilyInvite.description: Email-bound household invitation with assigned role and permissions.

homeName.description: Display name of the target household.

invitedEmail.description: Lowercase email address of the invited family member.

canUnlockDoor.description: Permission to unlock the front door via device confirmation.

invitedByUid.description: UID of the admin/owner who created the invite.

acceptedByUid.description: UID of the verified user who accepted the invite.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the invite was updated.

FamilyActivityEntry.title: FamilyActivityEntry
FamilyActivityEntry.description: Immutable household user activity log entry attributed to an authenticated user.

logId.description: Document ID of the activity entry.

actorUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user who performed the action.

actorName.description: Display name of the acting member.

actorRole.description: Role of the acting member at the time of the action.

actionTitle.description: Short summary of the action performed.

detail.description: Optional additional detail or voice transcript.

source.description: App surface where the action originated.

viewerUids.description: Bounded list (max 20) of household UIDs permitted to view this log entry.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity occurred.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/membership/{membershipId.description: Private household membership link for a user (doc id 'current').

/users/{userId}/homeState/{stateId}.description: Per-user simulated smart home state document (doc id 'default').

/users/{userId}/activities/{activityId}.description: Per-user simulated smart home recent activity log.

/users/{userId}/routines/{routineId}.description: Per-user customized automation routine configurations (sleep, morning, away).

/homes/{homeId}/members/{memberId}.description: Authorized family members and permissions within a household.

/homes/{homeId}/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable household user activity audit trail.

/homeInvites/{inviteCode}.description: Email-bound family member invitations keyed by invite code.
